name: svsch
description: Generate interactive visual block diagrams from SystemVerilog projects.

commands.title: svsch: Reset Layout For Current Module

svsch.fileList.description: Workspace-relative path to a Surelog filelist (.f file) passed to Surelog via -f. When set, this overrides svsch.projectFolder's directory walk entirely: only the files listed in the filelist are compiled. Auto-detection of header include directories no longer applies in this mode, so you must supply your own -I/+incdir+ (via svsch.includePaths or directives inside the filelist itself).

svsch.veriblePath.description: Path to the Verible verible-verilog-syntax executable.

svsch.parser.backend.description: Parser backend used to extract the design graph.

svsch.includePaths.description: Workspace-relative paths to search for include files.

svsch.defines.description: Macros to define for the preprocessor (e.g. { "DEBUG": "1" }).

svsch.minifySvg.description: Minify SVG diagrams exported via 'Export as SVG' using SVGO.

svsch.autocut-clk-reset.description: Automatically cut nets feeding register clock and reset pins when a module diagram is first opened.

scripts.compile: npm run clean && npm run build:webview && npx tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json && npm run compile:backend && SURELOG_AUTO_INSTALL=1 npm run install-surelog && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:webview: CI=true npx vite build && node scripts/copy-diagram-css.js
scripts.compile:backend: mkdir -p src/parser/backend_cpp/build && cd src/parser/backend_cpp/build && cmake .. -G Ninja && ninja svsch_backend && mkdir -p ../../../../dist/ && cp svsch_backend ../../../../dist/
scripts.compile:backend:coverage: mkdir -p src/parser/backend_cpp/build-coverage && cd src/parser/backend_cpp/build-coverage && cmake .. -G Ninja -DENABLE_COVERAGE=ON && ninja svsch_backend
scripts.package: SURELOG_AUTO_INSTALL=1 npm run compile && npx vsce package
scripts.release: SURELOG_AUTO_INSTALL=1 npm run compile && npx changeset publish && (npx ovsx publish -p $OVSX_PAT || echo 'Open VSX skipped')
scripts.watch: node scripts/copy-diagram-css.js --watch & vite build --watch & tsc -watch -p tsconfig.extension.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:tsc && npm run lint:eslint
scripts.lint:tsc: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.extension.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.webview.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cli.json
scripts.prepare: node scripts/install-surelog.js || true && patch-package && node scripts/setup-eslint-ts-shim.js
scripts.test:bdd: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE xvfb-run --auto-servernum playwright test --config test/bdd/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:bdd:update: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE xvfb-run --auto-servernum playwright test --config test/bdd/playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots=changed
scripts.test:system:single: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE xvfb-run --auto-servernum playwright test --config test/system/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:system:single:update: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE xvfb-run --auto-servernum playwright test --config test/system/playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots=changed
